name: fig10_extremal_limits
caption: Temperature, entropy and horizon angular velocity as functions of charge-to-mass ratio (RN) and spin (Kerr), normalised to the Schwarzschild values at equal M. T vanishes continuously at extremality with finite entropy; the Kerr Smarr relation M = 2TS + 2 Omega J holds to round-off (tests/test_spacetimes.py). The horizon radius is computed as sqrt((M-Q)(M+Q)) to avoid cancellation near extremality.
